Government schemes (Ayushman Bharat) provide insurance, but doctor-population ratio is still below WHO recommendations. Telemedicine is bridging some gaps, but quality concerns persist. The next phase requires sustained investment in primary healthcare, more medical professionals, and rigorous quality standards.
